name: ch1tprev
prompt: Edit reference 1 with a VERY LIMITED change: remove only its flat magenta padding, replace that padding with actual alpha=0 transparent PNG pixels. Preserve the textured rectangular strip, exact layout, colours, proportions, rivets, iron bands and coarse joins. Reference 2 shows the approved chest material quality: continuous grey-blue WOOD GRAIN, fine long parallel wood fibres, fine curving cracks, modest smooth rust, smooth rounded iron rivets. Keep that photographic/painted realistic quality; NOT a mosaic, carved rock, chunky bark, crushed scales, dither, square chips or speckled procedural noise. Where reference 1 has low-resolution pixels, redraw only those areas with the fine material from reference 2. Do not transform smooth wood into flakes, gravel or faceted brushstrokes. The rectangular strip must touch both long-axis ends of the canvas and be completely opaque, with perfectly straight edges. RGBA PNG: real transparent padding, opaque material. No fake black, magenta or checkerboard background. No labels. Preserve every original band and rivet count and the strip placement. Uniform diffuse albedo lighting. One strip only.
